name: 搜索大宝箱
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE fresh LANDSCAPE 4:3 game card illustration for 搜索大宝箱 (Search the Large Treasure Chest). Do NOT refer to any old card or existing composition. Inputs1/2 are drawing-style references ONLY: borrow LARGE opaque directional brush masses and rough economical form construction, never their characters, faces, clothes, hats or backgrounds. Opaque full canvas. No border, lettering, logos, watermark or UI.

DISTINCT ACTION / SHOT: a tilted overhead close shot from the searcher's viewpoint of ONE very large sturdy treasure chest being rummaged through. Big open chest dominates the middle/lower-left, thick raised lid diagonally spans upper-left, dark inner compartment and forearm gesture create depth. Only TWO generic hands/forearm ends enter from outside frame: upper-left hand grips/raises the lid edge, lower-right hand reaches INSIDE and pushes aside one broad folded piece of gray cloth to search. Hands anatomically clear, simple dark sleeves and natural skin hands, no full character or face, no specific hero identity, no extras. The searching hand should visibly rummage rather than point at the viewer.

TREASURE / CARD MEANING: EXACTLY THREE simple blank paper/talisman-shaped rectangular sheets are being uncovered at different angles inside the open chest; one pale ivory, one muted blue-gray, one dusty ochre. They are substantial readable shapes, partly overlapping but all three countable. One edge peeks above the chest rim, the other two are revealed under the folded cloth. No printed pictures, symbols, writing, numerals, card frames or tiny trading-card UI on them. These three discovered sheets symbolize the card's three random gains. Avoid a fountain of coin glitter or hundreds of small jewels. The SEARCH action and the large chest must remain the main story.

CHEST DESIGN: oversized squat heavy wooden chest with thick rough lids/boards, a few broad dark iron corner braces and restrained dull bronze front latch. Main chest body muted brown-gray and charcoal, NOT ornate fairy-tale gold filigree. Perspective of thick lid, broad sides and open interior is believable. Describe wood and metal in a FEW wide flat opaque strokes; no microscopic wood grain, detailed rivets, carved patterns or shiny metal engraving. ONE folded cloth mass inside, three papers, simple latch — stop before prop clutter. Keep outer box silhouette complete except natural lid/forearm frame crops, strong practical shape readable small.

BACKGROUND: pure large SOLID pale warm-gray and subdued slate-blue blocks in a simple diagonal division, ABSTRACT ONLY. No cave, floor, room, ruins, forest, grass, horizon, sky, environmental surface or detailed background. Chest floats as the central symbolic object in abstract color space; no physical cast shadow onto a ground. Interior darkness is part of the chest, not a backdrop. Opaque illustration, not transparent.

STYLE: VERY ROUGH hand-painted anime / game-prop gouache COLOR STUDY, visibly loose and unfinished. FEWER VERY LARGE blunt opaque swipes construct whole planes. A base color plus ONE large coherent shadow and 2–3 broad uneven midtone marks per plane; lots of calm color interiors. Irregular handmade edges, broken paint ends, small exposed color gaps and a handful of selected structural sketch strokes. Brush direction follows lid/body/cloth folds, not random texture. Hands drawn simply and readably, no polished skin rendering. Neutral colored grays, dull wood brown and iron charcoal with concentrated ivory/ochre paper accents. Mostly hard grouped light/shadow and matte painted surfaces.
Do not refine every edge or render every board crease. Roughness comes from fewer wider meaningful paint marks, NOT canvas/grain filters, pervasive tiny facets, chipped triangles, scratches or all-over noisy texture. No glossy 3D, photoreal wood/skin/metal, airbrush gradients, cinematic golden bloom, lens flare, particles, decorative runes, ornate jewels or extra clutter. Primary focus searching hand + dark chest opening + three revealed papers. Economical background. No text or watermark.
userDirection: 重绘搜索大宝箱，不参考原图；沿粗笔/抽象背景/不测试
